description: This file contains definitions for multiple classes that wrap and provide functional operations for quantized and floating point tensor computations in PyTorch. It defines classes `FloatFunctional`, `FXFloatFunctional`, and `QFunctional`, which encapsulate various tensor operations such as add, mul, cat, add_relu, and matmul, with some classes supporting quantization parameters. The file serves as a module providing these functional wrappers for internal and quantized tensor operations.

classes.name: FloatFunctional
classes.description: A class that wraps float tensor operations, allowing them to be used as module methods.

classes.name: FXFloatFunctional
classes.description: A simplified version of FloatFunctional designed for FX graph mode quantization, which does not include observe or state management.

classes.name: QFunctional
classes.description: A wrapper class providing quantized tensor operations with support for quantization parameters (scale and zero_point).

methods.name: Tensor add(self, x: Tensor, y: Tensor)
methods.description: Performs tensor addition, wrapping torch.add or ops.quantized.add depending on the class.

methods.name: Tensor add_scalar(self, x: Tensor, y: float)
methods.description: Performs addition of tensor and scalar, wrapping torch.add or ops.quantized.add_scalar.

methods.name: Tensor mul(self, x: Tensor, y: Tensor)
methods.description: Performs tensor multiplication, wrapping torch.mul or ops.quantized.mul.

methods.name: Tensor mul_scalar(self, x: Tensor, y: float)
methods.description: Performs multiplication of tensor and scalar, wrapping torch.mul or ops.quantized.mul_scalar.

methods.name: Tensor cat(self, x: list[Tensor], dim: int = 0)
methods.description: Concatenates a list of tensors along a specified dimension, wrapping torch.cat or ops.quantized.cat.

methods.name: Tensor add_relu(self, x: Tensor, y: Tensor)
methods.description: Performs addition followed by ReLU activation, wrapping torch.add, torch.nn.functional.relu, or ops.quantized.add_relu.

methods.name: Tensor matmul(self, x: Tensor, y: Tensor)
methods.description: Performs matrix multiplication, wrapping torch.matmul or ops.quantized.matmul.

methods.name: _save_to_state_dict(self, destination, prefix, keep_vars)
methods.description: Saves quantization parameters to state dict if applicable.

methods.name: _load_from_state_dict( self, state_dict, prefix, local_metadata, strict, missing_keys, unexpected_keys, error_msgs, )
methods.description: Loads quantization parameters from state dict if applicable.

methods.name: extra_repr(self)
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the quantization parameters.

methods.name: from_float(cls, mod, use_precomputed_fake_quant=False)
methods.description: Creates a QFunctional instance from a FloatFunctional, extracting quantization parameters.
